<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use App\Models\{Order, Product, Category, User, Review};

class BenchmarkBeforeAIController extends Controller
{
    # Before 
        public function orders()
    {
        return Order::all()->map(fn ($o) => [
            'id' => $o->id,
            'user' => $o->user->name,
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function orderShow(Order $order)
    {
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'user' => $order->user->name,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label,
            ]),
        ];
    }

    public function enterpriseOrder()
    {
        $order = Order::where('number', 'ENT-00001')->firstOrFail();
        return [
            'id' => $order->id,
            'items' => $order->items->map(fn ($item) => [
                'product' => $item->product->label,
            ]),
        ];
    }

    public function products()
    {
        return Product::all()->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'category' => optional($p->category)->label,
        ]);
    }

    public function productsByCategory(Category $category)
    {
        return Product::where('category_id', $category->id)->get();
    }

    public function productReviews(Product $product)
    {
        return $product->reviews->map(fn ($r) => [
            'rating' => $r->rating,
            'user' => $r->user->name,
        ]);
    }

    public function productsWithoutCategory()
    {
        return Product::whereNull('category_id')->get();
    }

    public function categoryProducts(Category $category)
    {
        return $category->products->map(fn ($p) => [
            'label' => $p->label,
            'reviews_count' => $p->reviews->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function userOrders(User $user)
    {
        return $user->orders->map(fn ($o) => [
            'number' => $o->number,
            'items_count' => $o->items->count(),
        ]);
    }

    public function recentReviews()
    {
        return Review::latest()->take(20)->get()->map(fn ($r) => [
            'product' => $r->product->label,
            'user' => $r->user->name,
        ]);
    }
}

Let me analyze each of the 10 methods for N+1 issues.

1. `orders()` - `Order::all()->map(fn ($o) => [...])`. This calls `$o->user` and `$o->items` for each order. N+1 issue: needs `with(['user', 'items'])`. Also `items_count` uses `$o->items->count()`. Fix: eager load.

2. `orderShow(Order $order)` - Route model binding loads single order. Then `$order->user` and `$order->items->map(...)` each item's `product`. This is an N+1 for items' products. Fix: `$order->load(['user', 'items.product'])`.

3. `enterpriseOrder()` - Same as orderShow. `Order::where('number', 'ENT-00001')->firstOrFail()`. N+1 for items and products. Fix: `->with(['items.product'])`.

4. `products()` - `Product::all()->map(...)` calls `$p->category`. N+1. Fix: `with('category')`.

5. `productsByCategory(Category $category)` - `Product::where('category_id', $category->id)->get()` - no relationships loaded. Not an N+1. Fine.

6. `productReviews(Product $product)` - `$product->reviews->map(...)` calls `$r->user` per review. N+1. Fix: `$product->load('reviews.user')`.

7. `productsWithoutCategory()` - no relationships. Not an N+1. Fine.

8. `categoryProducts(Category $category)` - `$category->products->map(...)` calls `$p->reviews->count()` per product. N+1. Fix: `$category->load('products.reviews')`.

9. `userOrders(User $user)` - `$user->orders->map(...)` calls `$o->items->count()` per order. N+1. Fix: `$user->load('orders.items')`.

10. `recentReviews()` - `Review::latest()->take(20)->get()->map(...)` calls `$r->product` and `$r->user` per review. N+1. Fix: `with(['product', 'user'])`.
